map.按目标总字数与章数规划章节配额，支持三幕 / 四段 / 均匀三种结构比例，输出各: Plan chapter quotas from the target word count and chapter count, supporting three-act / four-part / even structure ratios, and output each arc's word and chapter allocation, a per-chapter quota table and a character-profile template.
map.= 总字数 ÷ 目标章数；若该值小于「每章最少字数」，说明章数偏多，应减少章数或: = total words ÷ target chapters; if this is below the "min words per chapter", you have too many chapters and should reduce them or raise the total (the tool warns you).
map.：按选定模式把总字数与章数按比例切分 —— 三幕 25% / 50% / 25%: : split the total words and chapters by the chosen mode — three-act 25% / 50% / 25% (setup / confrontation / resolution, the mainstream commercial ratio); four-part 20% / 30% / 30% / 20%; or even splits. Chapters are rounded per ratio then tail-corrected so the sum equals the target.
map.= 总字数 ÷ 每日写作字数（天），并按 7 天/周折算周数。: = total words ÷ daily word count (days), converted to weeks at 7 days/week.
map.按「每章平均字数 × 该幕密度系数」生成，密度系数：铺设 0.9、对抗 1.05: Generated as "average words per chapter × that arc's density factor"; density: setup 0.9, confrontation 1.05, resolution 1.0, used to cross-check whether progress is lopsided.
map.📚 深度解析：小说章节配额与进度规划（三幕 / 四段 / 均匀）: 🍼 Deep Dive: Novel Chapter Quotas & Progress Planning (Three-act / Four-part / Even)
map.动笔前先定体量：确认 30 万字 / 120 章是否会导致「每章不足 2000: Set the scale before writing: check whether 300k words / 120 chapters would cause a "under 2000 words per chapter" structure problem
map.拆分写作计划：按每日字数估算完稿天数，据此安排更新节奏: Break down the writing plan: estimate days to finish from daily word count, then schedule your update cadence
map.阶段自检：对照各幕累计字数，判断是否长期停留在「对抗」幕而迟迟不进入收束: Stage self-check: compare cumulative words per arc to see if you are stuck too long in the "confrontation" arc and slow to reach resolution
map.每章平均字数 = 总字数 ÷ 章数；完成周期 = 总字数 ÷ 日均字数。结构分配: Average words per chapter = total words ÷ chapters; completion period = total words ÷ daily words. Three allocation options: three-act 25/50/25, four-part 20/30/30/20, or even 1/3 each; chapters per segment are rounded and the last segment takes the remainder so the total equals the target. Per-chapter quota = average words × arc density factor (setup 0.9 / confrontation 1.05 / resolution 1.0). When average words fall below the entered "min words per chapter", a warning appears and a feasible chapter count is computed (total ÷ min, floored).
map.20 万字 / 100 章 / 每章最少 2000 字 / 日均 5000 字: 200k words / 100 chapters / min 2000 / 5000 daily / three-act → 2000 words per chapter, 40 days (~5.7 weeks), total 200k, 2.50% daily progress; Act 1 25 chapters 50k, Act 2 50 chapters 100k, Act 3 25 chapters 50k. If changed to 50k / 200 chapters, average drops to 250 words/chapter; the page warns "below the set minimum of 2000" and suggests cutting chapters to about 25.
map.章数太多时页面会提示什么？: What does the page warn when there are too many chapters?
map.当每章平均字数低于你填写的「每章最少字数」时会给出警告，并算出可行章数 = 总字: When average words per chapter fall below your "min words per chapter", it warns you and computes a feasible chapter count = total ÷ min (floored), plus the required total-word floor, so you can choose between adding words or cutting chapters.
map.这个工具会代写小说正文吗？: Will this tool write the novel text for me?
map.不会。它只做章节配额与进度规划，输出各幕结构分配、逐章字数配额与完稿周期，并提供: No. It only plans chapter quotas and progress — outputting each arc's structure allocation, per-chapter word quotas and completion period, plus copyable character-profile / chapter-card templates; the text and copyright remain the author's.
map.三种结构模式该怎么选？: How to choose among the three structure modes?
map.三幕适合主流长篇与网文，冲突集中在第二幕；四段起承转合更适合有明确转折点的故事；: Three-act suits mainstream long-form and web novels, concentrating conflict in Act 2; four-part fits stories with clear turning points; even mode suits essay-style or short-story collections with balanced chapters. Switching mode only changes allocation, not total words or chapters.
map.章节配额按「总字数 ÷ 章数 × 密度系数」线性换算，结果确定可复现，不含任何随: Chapter quotas are a linear conversion of "total ÷ chapters × density factor" — deterministic and reproducible, with no random sampling
map.三幕 25/50/25 与四段 20/30/30/20 是常见结构配比的经验值，: Three-act 25/50/25 and four-part 20/30/30/20 are common empirical ratios, not the only standard; genre fiction can adjust to its real rhythm
map.章数按比例取整后做尾差修正，因此各幕章数之和恒等于目标章数: Chapters are rounded per ratio then tail-corrected, so each arc's chapter sum always equals the target
map.字数配额是规划参考，不替代大纲本身：先定幕目标与章节钩子，再按配额校验进度: Word quotas are planning references, not a substitute for the outline itself: set arc goals and chapter hooks first, then validate progress against the quotas

map.三种结构模式（三幕 / 四段起承转合 / 均匀）自动分配各幕字数与章数，含尾差修: Three structure modes (three-act / four-part / even) auto-allocate each arc's words and chapters, with tail correction
